gaps.title: Matched BPGD versus diffusion benchmark on identical BB codes
gaps.description: No result in the seven-paper seed set establishes a controlled comparison of BPGD and diffusion decoding with the same BB code instances, noise model, stopping rules, sample count, and hardware budget.
gaps.candidate_experiment: Select published BB codes; test BPGD, BP-OSD, and diffusion under identical phenomenological and circuit-level noise; report LER, latency, memory, training cost, and confidence intervals.
gaps.risk: Diffusion implementation and training details may not be fully reproducible from the paper alone.

gaps.title: Self-duality tradeoff study for BB codes
gaps.description: The seed literature does not quantify how self-duality and transversal Clifford requirements trade against code rate, distance, layout, stabilizer weight, and decoder performance.
gaps.candidate_experiment: Generate matched coprime BB families with and without self-dual constraints and compare structural and decoding metrics.
gaps.risk: Code-search space may be large and distance computation expensive.

gaps.title: Cross-noise robustness of BB constructions
gaps.description: BB-code claims span construction, erasure behavior, and logical-gate structure, but the seed set lacks a unified evaluation across erasure, depolarizing, biased, phenomenological, and circuit-level noise.
gaps.candidate_experiment: Evaluate a fixed BB code panel under multiple noise models using at least two decoder families and common logical-failure definitions.
gaps.risk: Circuit-level simulations may require substantial compute and careful syndrome-circuit design.

gaps.title: Decoder cost accounting including neural training
gaps.description: Decoder comparisons often emphasize inference latency or logical error rate without consistently including training, hyperparameter search, preprocessing, memory, and energy costs.
gaps.candidate_experiment: Define lifecycle cost metrics and publish accuracy-versus-total-compute Pareto curves for BP-OSD, BPGD, union-find, and diffusion-based methods where applicable.
gaps.risk: Cross-platform energy and cost measurements can be noisy.

gaps.title: Scaling beyond reported code sizes
gaps.description: The seed papers do not provide a common, independently replicated scaling study across decoder families and code constructions.
gaps.candidate_experiment: Run increasing code sizes until memory, latency, convergence, or sampling precision becomes limiting; fit empirical scaling laws with uncertainty.
gaps.risk: Low logical error rates demand importance sampling or very large Monte Carlo budgets.

gaps.title: Reproducibility and implementation completeness audit
gaps.description: The evidence set has not yet established whether all algorithms, hyperparameters, code instances, random seeds, and evaluation scripts needed for replication are publicly available.
gaps.candidate_experiment: Create a reproducibility checklist for all seven papers and attempt minimal reruns before launching novel experiments.
gaps.risk: Missing code or undocumented details may require author contact or independent reimplementation.
